delivered.statement: Topline up 25% from oil prices; Jio up 12%, retail up 12%
EBITDA Rs 54,000+ crores, up 10% YoY excluding Rs 8,900 cr Asian Paints
Net profit nearly Rs 23,200 crores, up 6% year-on-year
533 million total subscribers; 285 million on 5G; 73M 5G additions in 12 months
ARPU Rs 215.6, up Rs 7 YoY without tariff increases; per capita 43.7 GB
78% FWA market share of net additions; 14M Air Fiber homes out of 28.6M
Grocery digital orders up 116% YoY; transactions up 46%; revenue Rs 90,000 cr
FMCG Rs 8,600 crores, double growth YoY; Independence rated India's most trusted
Refinery throughput 96-97% despite supply disruptions and planned maintenance turnaround
O2C EBITDA up 17%, revenue up 30% amid Middle East supply dislocation

themes: Middle East supply disruption created margin opportunities despite crude sourcing challenges
Digital commerce expansion sacrifices near-term margins for JioMart retail scale
Jio technology dominance: 285M 5G users, 78% FWA, AI cloud monetization
New energy manufacturing integration: solar, batteries, green fuels at Jamnagar
Navigated commodity volatility via ethane advantage, refining benefits, crude premiums
FMCG brand building: Independence, Campa acquisitions, pan-India distribution expansion
risks: Geopolitical escalation: Strait of Hormuz hostilities resumed; crude availability and pricing volatile
Freight and insurance cost spikes (10x normal) offset refining margin gains
Retail EBITDA margins pressured by digital commerce investments; FY27 margin decline intentional
Petrochemical feedstock constraints: LPG diversion and gas curtailment impacted production demand

analyst_pushback.question: Digital services 20% growth—will it accelerate?
analyst_pushback.response: Scope for more monetization but careful on forward guidance. Margins improve with scale.

analyst_pushback.question: ARPU flat QoQ despite mix improvements—where is pressure?
analyst_pushback.response: ARPU not under pressure. Homes mix lower than mobility; 4-5% organic improvement ongoing.

analyst_pushback.question: How long will quick commerce dark store investments continue?
analyst_pushback.response: Minimum 12 months. Discipline on unit economics required. Pull back if assumptions fail.

analyst_pushback.question: Full-year capex guidance and incremental allocation?
analyst_pushback.response: Cannot specify capex. Framework: maintain ratings, debt ratios. Flexibility to phase, evaluate partners.

tone_evidence: Confident on tech leadership, refining advantages. Defensive on forward guidance: 'too hypothetical', 'impossible to crystallize'.
